description: Query GPU utilization using an explicitly supplied gpu_metric or the activation's verified default mapping. hostname alone works only when that default exists. Ready/authenticated does not establish a default GPU mapping. Missing configuration is gpu_metric_not_configured (HTTP 400); no_data means a successful query returned no samples.

hostname.description: Exact node-label value from Prometheus samples; not inferred from a VM display name.

name.description: Actual GPU utilization metric name discovered from this Grafana datasource.

node_label.description: Exact, case-sensitive node label, for example hostname or Hostname; verify actual samples.

index_label.description: Label containing the numeric GPU index, verified from actual samples.

uuid_label.description: Optional label containing the GPU UUID, verified from actual samples.

unit.description: Metric unit: percent is already 0–100; ratio is 0–1 and is multiplied by 100.

gpu_metric.description: Verified Prometheus metric and case-sensitive label mapping. Overrides the activation default. Required at call time when the activation has no default gpu_metric; omission then fails with gpu_metric_not_configured (HTTP 400). Discover the metric, labels and unit with dashboard_get / gpu_arena_describe and metrics_query before supplying this mapping.
